legend-copper-coast-drive.story: UNESCO geopark touring route. sea cliffs, coves, geology. From Trá Mhór it runs 55 km to Dungarvan; allow about 1 h of riding. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Copper Coast Drive
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 11 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 7 km this is Route 62, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
